mapper.sql: id, actor_identity_id AS actor, idempotency_key AS key, operation, target_id AS targetId, created_at AS createdAt, replay_until AS replayUntil, response_body::TEXT AS responseBody, request_body::TEXT AS requestBody
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO plan_recovery(actor_identity_id, idempotency_key, operation, target_id, created_at, replay_until, request_body) VALUES (#{actor}, #{key}, #{operation}, #{targetId}, #{createdAt}, #{replayUntil}, CAST(#{requestBody} AS JSONB)) ON CONFLICT (actor_identity_id, idempotency_key) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT FROM plan_recovery WHERE actor_identity_id = #{actor} AND idempotency_key = #{key}
SELECT FROM plan_recovery WHERE actor_identity_id = #{actor} AND id = #{id}

SELECT CASE WHEN operation = 'CREATE' THEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM plans WHERE code = request_body->>'code') AND (request_body->>'limit')::INTEGER >= 1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM quota_definitions WHERE id = (request_body->>'quotaDefinitionId')::UUID AND quota_definition_status = 'ACTIVE') ELSE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM plans p JOIN plan_quotas q ON q.plan_id = p.id JOIN quota_definitions d ON d.id = q.quota_definition_id WHERE p.id = target_id AND p.plan_status = 'DRAFT' AND q.quota_limit >= 1 AND d.quota_definition_status = 'ACTIVE') END FROM plan_recovery WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE plan_recovery SET response_body = CAST(#{responseBody} AS JSONB), replay_until = #{replayUntil} WHERE id = #{id} AND actor_identity_id = #{actor} AND response_body IS NULL
